Acceptance:
1. Authenticate every original candidate and complete consumed source/comparison product, source row/hash join and exact stable owner. Preserve all nineteen outcomes including held or failed cases.

3. Reuse admitted methods, literal BASE OR full unchanged original candidate policy and immutable old primitive retention. Apply full source/physical support and no foreign-owner overlap. Preserve earlier dissolved diagnostics; incremental continuous area is unknown unless separately measured. No snap, buffer, normalization, floating residual or country-specific exception.
4. Use cheap metadata/source/current-owner checks before expensive physical inverses. Restore exact whole original physical products/query metadata only for viable cases. Test both the actual pure SOURCE premise and the earlier full consumed source feature/geometry join. Coordinate frozen method/runtime; a queued method is not admitted.
5. Produce a genuinely independently reviewed v2 source handoff only for the actually executable-ready subset. All original IDs remain accounted for. A zero-supported result requires precise blockers for every member. Normal source CI, exact-head source/geometry review and merge queue are required. No selected/native delivery or global closure credit.
6. Keep original regional work #163/#164/#165/#166/#167/#168 and #292/#293 unchanged. Cocos component 9d53e507a92cc13f65caf2dc51679708b3fee6e5b87a670c5d5179e40019dbbe overlaps #1453's independently owned official physical observation-fitness scope; preserve it as held and do not duplicate its source acquisition or resolve its unknown/unapproved physical status here. No shared owned paths, production/provider actions, new regional approval or legal roster reconciliation.
7. Use the managed cloud slot and authenticated pinned runtime/import closure. Initial metadata reservation is 256 MiB RSS with 128 MiB logical phases; larger GIS phases need fresh documented admission against coordinator reservations, 2 GiB parent reserve and 768 MiB residual headroom. No full-global hydration.
